blocks.title: Earn

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the IHG One Rewards portfolio, including InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add IHG One Rewards: retain InterContinental Hotels & Resorts's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Luxury / upper-upscale full-service: grand public space, elevated F&B, and IHG One Rewards distribution for global travelers.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.
